input.description: Verify main with ACSL for WP
input.prompt:
You are an ACSL/Frama-C WP specification engineer. Apply the spec-bottomup methodology to a single C source file to prove all its `//@ assert` assertions.

## Task
The file to verify is:
[TASK]/workspace/output/layer0/main/main.c

This file contains the function `main` with three loops and one `//@ assert(c[i] >= 3)` assertion inside the third loop. Add ALL necessary ACSL loop annotations (loop invariant / loop assigns / loop variant) to prove the assertion.

## Project-tool verification command
The Frama-C + WP toolchain is invoked through this exact python module (CWD is the workspace):
```
cd "[TASK]/workspace"
"/Users/dijkstra/ACSL-Agent 2/acsl模块化验证/.venv/bin/python" -m engine.harness_spectool extract --src <file.c>
"/Users/dijkstra/ACSL-Agent 2/acsl模块化验证/.venv/bin/python" -m engine.harness_spectool verify --file <file.c> --timeout 60 --save-stdout <file.wp.txt>
"/Users/dijkstra/ACSL-Agent 2/acsl模块化验证/.venv/bin/python" -m engine.harness_spectool locate-fail --wp <file.wp.txt> --src <file.acsl.c>
```

## Steps
1. Read the input file: [TASK]/workspace/output/layer0/main/main.c
2. Understand the three loops:
   - Loop 1 (for i in [0,N)): sets a[i]=1 and b[i]=2
   - Loop 2 (for i in [0,N)): sets c[i]=a[i]+b[i]
   - Loop 3 (for i in [1,N)): contains `//@ assert(c[i] >= 3)`
3. Write the annotated file to:
   [TASK]/workspace/output/layer0/main/main.acsl.c
   using a file-write tool. You MUST add loop annotations for EVERY loop. Required annotation pattern:
   - Loop 1: 
     - loop invariant 0 <= i <= N;
     - loop invariant \forall integer j; 0 <= j < i ==> a[j] == 1;
     - loop invariant \forall integer j; 0 <= j < i ==> b[j] == 2;
     - loop assigns i, a[0 .. N-1], b[0 .. N-1];
     - loop variant N - i;
   - Loop 2:
     - loop invariant 0 <= i <= N;
     - loop invariant \forall integer j; 0 <= j < N ==> a[j] == 1;   (carry full a knowledge)
     - loop invariant \forall integer j; 0 <= j < N ==> b[j] == 2;   (carry full b knowledge)
     - loop invariant \forall integer j; 0 <= j < i ==> c[j] == 3;
     - loop assigns i, c[0 .. N-1];
     - loop variant N - i;
   - Loop 3:
     - loop invariant 1 <= i <= N;
     - loop invariant \forall integer j; 0 <= j < N ==> c[j] == 3;   (carry full c knowledge)
     - loop assigns i;
     - loop variant N - i;
   IMPORTANT: Preserve the original C tokens and the original `//@ assert(c[i] >= 3)` line EXACTLY as-is. Only ADD annotations.
4. Run the verify command on main.acsl.c. Iterate (fix annotations) up to 5 rounds until `proved == total` (result Pass), or as close as possible.
5. NEVER add admit, assume, axiom, or unproved fallback contracts. Platform policy forbids them.
6. Write the final verified annotated file to main.acsl.c and the WP output to main.wp.txt (via the verify --save-stdout flag or writing it).

## Report
Return a JSON result on stdout in this exact format:
{"file": "main.c", "status": "pass" or "fail", "round": N, "proved": N, "total": N, "elapsed_sec": N, "tokens": <estimated>, "error": null or description}
Only report status "pass" if proved == total. Also state the final contents of main.acsl.c in your reply so the parent can merge annotations.
